description_en: Creates or modifies scheduled tasks on cloud computers, such as starting, stopping, restarting, and resetting cloud computers on schedule
description_zh: 创建或修改云电脑定时任务，例如定时开机、关机、重启、重置等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-timer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-asuk39x45qnjp0000 --desktop-timers TimerType=TimerBoot Enforce=true AllowClientSetting=true ResetType=RESET_TYPE_SYSTEM CronExpression=0_0_16_0_0_1,2,3,4,5,6,7 OperationType=Shutdown Interval=10 --use-desktop-timers true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopTimer

element_fields.description_en:
The cron expression of the schedule.

> The time must be in UTC. For example, for 24:00 (UTC+8), you must set the value to 0 0 16 ? \* 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

><notice>需要传入UTC标准时间，即北京时间每天0点应该传入0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7></notice>
